task: Add a non-interactive device-code-style SSO login flow (print URL, accept pasted token) for headless machines without a local browser (EPMCDME-16958).

key_reasoning.reason: The backend contract for a non-loopback login and a displayable or pasteable token is outside this repo and unverified (issue #229 not read). Whether the detached sso-login, setup-steps and auth-helper callers take the new mode is an open design decision.

No precedent in the SSO module for a paste-token flow. The pasted token carries session cookies, so prompt and echo handling and log sanitization are security-sensitive. The closest pattern, handleCallback parsing, is private and coupled to the HTTP request, and it does not cover input validation of untrusted pasted text.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk held at L: secret handling of a pasted token has no existing pattern covering the input-validation and echo surface
